{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Check the data
print(data.dtypes)
print(data.head())
print(f"\nShape: {data.shape}")
print(f"\nUnique patient_id count: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"\nTotal rows: {len(data)}")

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of -999 values in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_count = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"\nNumber of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}")

# Check sample_seq distribution per patient_id
duplicates = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)].sort_values('patient_id')
dup_summary = duplicates.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().reset_index()
print(f"\nSummary of duplicate patient_id rows (highest sample_seq per patient):\n{dup_summary}")"}
